sentences.text: Victim A vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 14 August, 2024

Author: Vishal Dhagat
Bench: Vishal Dhagat

1 Wp-23038-2024 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur Wp No. 23038
of 2024 (Victim A Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others ) Dated : 14-08-2024
Ms. Priyanka Tiwari - Advocate for the petitioner.

entities.text: High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri A. K. Sharma - Govt. Advocate for the State.

Petitioner has filed this petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India making allegations that Police Department is not taking action against accused persons against whom petitioner has lodged a report under Section 376(2)(N) of the Indian Penal Code.
Govt. Advocate for the State prays for short time to seek instructions in the mater and file affidavit.
It is submitted by counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is being harassed by Police Officer and she is being repeatedly called at police station.
Till next date of hearing, petitioner may not be called at police station in respect of complaint made by her.
List this matter in the week commencing from 2.9.2024.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE AD/
